To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the complexity of the system is the main determinant of the system's reliability.
the dependence of the components within each element and between the elements in a complex system is a key factor in the system reliability.
The reliability of a complex system is not a linear combination of the reliabilities of its elements.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the reliability of complex systems.
the study of the dependence of components in complex systems, and the relationship between the reliability of a system and the dependence of components within it.
the development of a new approach for modeling the reliability of complex systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a complex system is one in which many factors are interconnected in a way that no one factor can be considered independently of another, but rather the system as a whole must be considered.
the reliability of a system depends on the reliability of its elements, the way in which these elements are connected, the way in...
the components of the system are dependent on each other and the reliability of each component depends on the reliability of the other components in the system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found the following: (1) A new class of systems with non-trivial topological features, which are characterized by the presence of a non-trivial topography of the network.

we have shown that the reliability of the system can be increased by increasing the reliability of the components, by reducing the number of components, or by reducing the dependency between the components.
we have developed a new approach for the reliability analysis of complex systems, which is based on the concept of component dependence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reliability of a complex system can be significantly enhanced by using components that are more reliable than the average.
, in general, the dependence of the components of complex systems is not a good indicator of the reliability of the system.
the reliability of a component is not the only factor to be considered when designing systems, and that reliability of a system is not simply a sum of the reliabilities of the components.
